==English==

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:bor|la-med:contemporārius}}
From {{bor|en|la-med|contemporārius}}, from {{der|en|la|con-|t=with, together}} + {{m|la|temporārius}}, an adjective derived from {{m|la|tempus|t=time}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɛm.p(ə.)ɹə.ɹi/|q2=informal or fast speech|/kənˈtɛm.p(ə.)ɹi/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/kənˈtɛm.pəˌɹɛɹ.i/|a=GA}}
** {{audio|en|En-contemporary.oga}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-contemporary.wav|a=Texas}}
* {{hyphenation|en|con|tem|po|ra|ry}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# From the same [[time]] [[period]], [[coexistent]] in time; [[contemporaneous]].
#: {{synonyms|en|coetaneous|coeval|contemporaneous|Thesaurus:contemporary}}
#: {{antonyms|en|anachronistic|qq=approximately}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=a. 1667|author=w:Abraham Cowley|url=https://en.wikisource.org/wiki/Essays_(Cowley)/The_Dangers_of_an_Honest_Man_in_much_Company#Section23|title=Claudian's Old Man of Verona
|passage=A neighb'ring Wood born with himself he sees, / And loves his old '''contemporary''' trees.}}
#* {{RQ:Strype Ecclesiastical Memorials|volume=I|chapter=A Notable Book Came Forth, Called, ''A Supplication of the Poor Commons to the King''; Shewing the Late State of the Kingdom.{{nb...|The King’s Care for the Education of His Children in Learning. Praises of the King. Leagues, Conventions, &c. in this King’s Reign.}}|page=407|passage=As this King [{{w|Henry VIII}}] vvas '''contemporary''' vvith the greateſt Monarchs of ''Europe'', ''viz.'' the Emperor, the Kings of ''Spain'' and ''France'', ſo he vvas engaged in many VVars, and in divers Leagues and Pacifications vvith them or either of them; for the better conſulting the Peace of Mankind.}}
# {{senseid|en|modern}} [[modern|Modern]], of the [[present]] age (shorthand for ‘contemporary with the present’).
#: {{synonyms|en|current|modern|Thesaurus:present}}
#: {{antonyms|en|archaic|coming}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# Someone or something belonging to the same time period (as someone or something else)
#: {{ux|en|Cervantes was a '''contemporary''' of Shakespeare.}}
#: {{ux|en|The early mammals inherited the earth by surviving their saurian '''contemporaries'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian
|date=2018-01-01
|author=Donald McRae
|title=The Guardian footballer of the year 2017: Juan Mata
|url=https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/jan/01/guardian-footballer-of-the-year-2017-juan-mata
|passage=Life is predicated by the decisions and choices we make – and, earlier this year, the personal fused with the professional again as Mata reached the landmark moment when he knew he had to try to harness football’s power for the benefit of people less fortunate than him and his '''contemporaries'''.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180202142504/https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/jan/01/guardian-footballer-of-the-year-2017-juan-mata}}
#* {{quote-web|en|author=Katherine Cross|title=The Oscar Wilde of YouTube fights the alt-right with decadence and seduction|work=w:The Verge|url=https://www.theverge.com/tech/2018/8/24/17689090/contrapoints-youtube-natalie-wynn|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20230211220210/https://www.theverge.com/tech/2018/8/24/17689090/contrapoints-youtube-natalie-wynn|format=news|publisher={{w|Vox (website)|Vox}}|date=2018-08-24|text=More than most of her '''contemporaries''' on “LeftTube,” [Contrapoints] has a style; her editorial signature is an unmistakably ornate flourish.}}
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Steven Poole|title='Insurrection': how an old word for an old thing was Trumped|url=https://www.theguardian.com/books/2021/jan/13/insurrection-how-an-old-word-for-an-old-thing-was-trumped|date=2021-01-13|passage=Thinking more metaphorically, his American '''contemporary''' James Russell Lowell wrote: “It is not the insurrections of ignorance that are dangerous, but the revolts of intelligence.” Had he lived to the year 2021, he might have changed his mind.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20210120100529/https://www.theguardian.com/books/2021/jan/13/insurrection-how-an-old-word-for-an-old-thing-was-trumped}}
# Something [[existing]] at the same time.
## {{lb|en|dated}} A [[rival]] [[newspaper]] or [[magazine]]. <!--Chambers 1908-->
##* {{quote-journal|en|year=1900|journal=The Speaker, the Liberal Review|volume=2|page=621
|passage=Annexation therefore was inevitable; but (as I have said above) it was not necessarily of prime importance in our national policy, and there has been no need to exaggerate—as I fear many of our '''contemporaries''' have exaggerated— {{...}}}}
